items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: in the brass band I had Sheik and Orny Canyon Leonard. Sometimes used three trumpets, sometimes used two trumpets and three reeds and Jesse Charles. And used Clarence and I used Louis Couture or Willie Humphrey.

ctx.x: Did you name the favorites in the brass band?

Well, they're always my favorite, but in the brass band I had Sheik and Orny Canyon Leonard. Sometimes used three trumpets, sometimes used two trumpets and three reeds and Jesse Charles. And used Clarence and I used Louis Couture or Willie Humphrey.
